# ClassicPro 2.01 engine resources

Unmodified engine data and MAKI source extracted from `ClassicPro_2.01.exe`
in https://www.mywinamp.com/downloads/ClassicPro_2.01.zip.
The Windows installer was not executed. Windows native plugins and bundled
example skins are not included. See `License.rtf` for the original license and
credits; its source/binary redistribution conditions apply to these resources.

SHA-256:

- ZIP: `763be54c3f807bcb0e70f21df055bf3eb29892661dacabee4be609514525f556`
- Installer: `c98a1b4472ad088fa1b98f51c0409524611ea0fdf85616fbcd3450ac9744098d`

Kog runs the XML and MAKI resources inside its browser skin runtime, not as native
Winamp plugins. Compatibility adaptations live outside this vendor directory.
